art_direction: 奶油黄底，沉重眼皮下轻轻抬眼，像刚刚醒来。
composition_variation: Set the right center higher and its opening larger while keeping BOTH lids heavy. Place the generous pupils just above their opening centers, tucked against the lid undersides, so the gaze lifts while the lids lag. Rounded lower edges and unequal lid pressure should suggest slowly waking. Preserve exactly TWO eyes with the SAME iris hue, large black pupils and one slim elongated ivory glint each. Emotion comes only from the eye geometry and gaze. Use matte gouache, organic curved tapered boundaries and a visibly pale colored ground; no eyebrows, mouth, head, sclera or other marks.
visible_subject: two eye graphics only; no eyebrows, mouth or head
style_inspiration: Latest user chat image observed locally: a mildly disdainful asymmetric gaze in opaque hand-painted black and cyan eye shapes. Only a written description was transmitted. No chat attachment was uploaded or used as binary input. Earlier eyes-only constraint retained.
visual_review: passed: inspected compressed contact sheet for readable eye expression, coordinated same-color irises, matte curved brush shapes, comfortable pastel background, no added face features, text or watermark
